candidate: Migration serialization lives in `django/db/migrations/serializer.py`; `DeconstructableSerializer._serialize_path` builds import statements from a deconstructed path's module. Emit `import <top-level-package>` (module.split(".",1)[0]), not the full dotted module, since the path uses the fully-qualified name.
Field deconstruct paths use `'%s.%s' % (self.__class__.__module__, self.__class__.__qualname__)`, so inner/nested classes appear as fully-qualified dotted paths in migrations.

Running `tests/runtests.py` requires Django importable on the path; a bare `python3 tests/runtests.py` fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'django'` unless the environment is set up (e.g. installed/editable).
